issues.description: The problem statement requires a variable named `shared_data` to be globally visible for tests, but the template repository does not declare `shared_data` at all, and the solution repository declares `shared_data` in the .data section without exporting it as a global symbol. This is a structural/visibility mismatch: students receive a template that lacks the required shared symbol (so they have no starting point), and the provided solution would not satisfy the stated requirement because it fails to mark `shared_data` as global. As a result tests that expect a globally visible `shared_data` symbol may fail and students will be confused about where/how to provide it.
issues.suggested_fix:
Ensure the `shared_data` symbol exists in the template and is exported as global in both template and solution. For example, in template_repository/helloWorld.asm add inside the .data section:  
    shared_data dd 0
and add at top-level (near other global declarations):  
    global shared_data
Also update the solution (or ensure it already matches) so it declares the same symbol and includes `global shared_data` (e.g. add `global shared_data` and keep `shared_data dd 100`). This makes the requirement explicit in the starter code and ensures the reference solution satisfies the problem statement.
